caption: The drawing features a single cylindrical metal lantern with a pointed, conical top. The lantern is primarily brown in color with darker and lighter shades to indicate shadows and reflections on the metal surface. The surface of the lantern is decorated with intricate punched patterns, primarily consisting of small holes arranged in circular and linear designs. The lantern has a door that is open towards the right, revealing the inside. On the floor of the lantern’s interior, there is a short white candle standing upright. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The artist's name, “Florian Rokita,” is written in small letters near the lower right corner.
title: Pierced Iron Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
